lines.text: Working at height, and confined spaces.
Work at height must be properly planned, with the right access equipment, and protection against falls.
And never remove edge protection, or alter scaffolding, without authorisation.
Confined spaces, like manholes, chambers, tanks, and wet wells, can kill.
No one enters a confined space without the assessment,
and a rescue plan in place.
Rescue must be planned before anyone goes in.
If someone collapses, never go in after them. Raise the alarm, and follow the rescue plan.
Plan the work. Protect the edge. Never enter unprepared.
